summary: Preserve Electron behavior where disabling background throttling on one WebContents affects all WebContents in the host BrowserWindow.

target.notes: Preserve Electron WebContents/Chromium renderer semantics through the ElectronCompat host boundary; do not replace navigation, rendering, printing, or DevTools with ordinary .NET calls.

semantics.scope: all WebContents in hosting BrowserWindow are affected when false
semantics.reenable: host policy must account for multiple contents/requesters

tests.name: cross contents
tests.input: a.setBackgroundThrottling(false); /* a and b hosted in same BrowserWindow */
tests.expected_behavior: window-level background behavior can affect b too

tests.name: not local flag
tests.expected_behavior: must not be represented solely as per-object C# boolean
